name: Konsinye Deposu paneli — açılır ve konsinye ürünü listeler

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible

Click the header button 'Konsinye Deposu' and wait 3 seconds for the panel to load. SAFETY RULE for the whole test: this panel contains buttons that permanently modify live production stock. Never click 'Ana Stoğa İade' or 'Faturalandı'. Only read and close.
A panel titled 'Konsinye Deposu' is visible with the section heading 'Konsinyede Bekleyen Ürünler'
The panel's table header cells include 'Ürün' and 'Konsinye'
The table contains a row for the product named 'Konsinye Demo Ürünü' whose barcode cell reads 'KONSINYE-DEMO-01', whose main stock cell reads '0' and whose consignment cell reads '5'
That same row renders two buttons labelled 'Ana Stoğa İade' and 'Faturalandı'. Confirm they are rendered but DO NOT click either of them.
Close the panel using its close control (or the overlay), without clicking any action button
The 'Konsinye Deposu' panel is no longer visible and the products dashboard is shown again
